root_cause.t153_zero_window_reporting: The bounded runner used a zero-valued fallback whenever a child timed out before writing its final group JSON. XAUUSD had valid windows, but the partial aggregate reported library_windows=0. The child heartbeat now records window counts before matching starts, and the parent preserves them in partial evidence.
root_cause.nsxusd_source: The current applied Pod image has the canonical /workspace/data/lake/NSXUSD/1m tree. A legacy fallback for NAS100/1m_capital (and NAS100/1m or US100/1m) is now supported for older images; the mapping is only used when the canonical tree is empty.
root_cause.continuity_rule: Exact timeframe spacing remains the safe rule for 1m/3m/5m bars. For 60m bars only, the confirmed HistData daily 20:00/21:00-to-23:00 UTC break is skipped in trading time; weekend and unknown gaps remain hard boundaries. This preserves in-session bars without allowing arbitrary missing data. NSXUSD still has additional same-day missing hourly bars, so its 60m group is stopped rather than treated as a valid study.
